paragraphs: Neḥemyah of Beit Deli. R. Akiva met him when he went to Nehardea to intercalate years. He told him he had heard Rabban Gamliel the elder, in Temple times, say a single witness is valid for a woman's marital-status testimony. He also told him that R. Yehudah ben Bava held likewise. R. Akiva testified in his name, and Rabban Gamliel, the elder Gamliel's grandson, rejoiced, Yevamot 115a, and the Mishnah at 122a; Eduyot 8:5. R. Akiva testified in his name.
